Strategy: Reward a wide absolute band of leftovers between twenty-five and fifty, with no penalty elsewhere, so many placements get a mild preference for mid-size leftovers. It may help by casting a wider net than the narrow band, but may fail by rewarding too many bins to change the ranking.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) for r in bins]
```
